widgets_values: Mei is exactly the woman on the character sheet in reference 1: same face, black hair in a low ponytail, cream long-sleeved button blouse with rolled sleeves, grey trousers with a thin dark belt. She is right-handed and holds only one phone when a phone is in the scene. 6:40 pm in a crowded Hong Kong MTR carriage, heading home to Kwun Tong. Follow the composition of reference 2: medium shot, Mei standing in the centre-right of frame, canvas tote bag on her left shoulder, her left hand gripping the yellow vertical pole, her right hand holding one smartphone at chest height, looking down at it, tired after work. The phone screen shows a grid of small colourful food pictures, no readable text. Behind her: blue overhead grab handles, other yellow poles, a few understated commuters looking at their own phones, and carriage windows with blurred dusk city lights.
